_description: Complete Claude Code settings with all recommended hooks
_requirements: Copy scripts/ to .claude/hooks/ and make executable

hooks.command: just catchup 2>/dev/null || echo 'No catchup recipe available'

python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); patterns=[r'\.env$',r'\.env\.',r'\.env/',r'credentials/',r'secrets/',r'api-keys\.',r'/production\.',r'/prod\.',r'\.git/']; match=any(re.search(pat,p) for pat in patterns); sys.exit(2) if match else sys.exit(0)" || (echo 'Warning: python3 unavailable, protected-files check skipped' >&2; exit 0)
